model.architecture: VibeVoice-ASR: σ-VAE acoustic encoder + semantic encoder (SEANet/ConvNeXt-1d, 24 kHz -> 7.5 Hz latents) -> projector -> Qwen2.5-1.5B-shaped BitNet (ternary) LM; LiteRT-LM generic audio path (raw-waveform frames, no mel)

variants.quantization: LM: per-tensor ternary weights (VibeASR.cpp absmean, applied at conversion) stored as int4 blockwise-128 min-max (exact for a ternary tensor), int8 embedding; audio encoder: int8 dynamic on linears, fp32 convs, 30 s (225-frame) window

recommended.reason: LM on Metal: 2045 tok/s prefill / 139 tok/s decode vs 357 / 59 on CPU; the audio encoder stays on CPU (audio_backend cpu) — on Metal/WebGPU the 30 s window exceeds the 65535 workgroup dispatch limit

Galaxy S26: LM on OpenCL 652 tok/s prefill / 36 tok/s decode vs 163 / 35 on CPU, transcripts match the Mac GPU run; the audio encoder must stay on CPU (audio_backend cpu) — on the GPU delegate it returns an empty transcript

platform_notes: Audio only through the runtime's generic audio path: send the clip as an audio content item (wav/mp3/flac; any sample rate — the engine resamples to 24 kHz) plus the text 'This is a X.XX seconds audio, please transcribe it.' (X.XX = clip length); with no text the bundle's template sends 'Please transcribe it.' (+0.9 pp WER on the fixture set)
audio_backend must be cpu (--audio_backend=cpu / audio_backend=CPU()); the LM may run on gpu
The encoder window is 30 s; longer clips are chunked by the engine with a context reset at each 30 s boundary

Accuracy: 20 LibriSpeech dev-clean clips (448 words): WER 2.68 % on macOS CPU and 2.46 % LM-on-GPU (fp32 PyTorch reference 2.68 %), 3.12 % Galaxy S26 CPU, 2.46 % Galaxy S26 LM-on-GPU; vendor card Libri-clean 2.41 % (full test set, VibeASR.cpp)
Peak private footprint on Galaxy S26: 3227 MB CPU/CPU, 2268 MB LM-on-GPU (--report_peak_memory_footprint, 5.9 s clip)

measured.source: litert-lm benchmark -p 256 -d 256 --runs 3 --cache no --backend cpu (text prompt; LM only)
litert-lm benchmark -p 256 -d 256 --runs 3 --cache no --backend gpu (text prompt; LM only; rested >= 300 s)
--benchmark with a 264-token text prompt, one reading (LM only)
--benchmark with a 264-token text prompt, one reading (LM only; audio encoder on CPU)

known_issues: Audio encoder does not run on the GPU delegates: on Metal/WebGPU the 30 s window dispatches 90001+ workgroups per stem kernel (limit 65535); on Adreno (OpenCL, all 1857 nodes delegated) the fp16 path returns an empty transcript; keep audio_backend=cpu

Audio placeholder tokens <|object_ref_start|>/<|object_ref_end|>/<|box_start|> are added to the bundled tokenizer.json (ids 151646/151647/151648, the ids the model was trained with); the upstream tokenizer.json has no string for them
